name: Zajchik
source:
Tiny Bunny is a non-linear horror visual novel.

Everything falls into slumber when winter comes, but not this forest. There's something wandering its snow-covered paths, lurking behind black trees and taking whatever it considers due. It leaves behind bizarre rumors of voices, calling you into the thicket, of faces, looking into your windows, of mysterious prints in the snow and... a bunch of "child missing" posters.
Those, who have heard the voice of the forest, are beyond help. Their only option is to sink deeper and deeper into the cold embrace of horror to face their final choice in that icy darkness: to stay alive or to stay human?

The story takes place in a quiet, unremarkable village lost among the Siberian forest. The protagonist, Anton, had recently moved there with his family and was almost immediately forced to witness and participate in a chain of unsettling events. It's a place where children go missing. The police are powerless, search teams are combing out the forest, but they find no traces. Why, then, is Anton repeatedly coming across prints, bloodstains, and scraps of clothing? It almost feels like someone is putting up a show just for him. He is haunted by nightmares at first, which grow more and more frightening and bloody every night. They also grow increasingly real ... and beckoning.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249880/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《小兔子》是一部非线性恐怖视觉小说。

冬天来临时，万物都会沉睡，但这片森林却不然。有什么东西在冰雪覆盖的小路上徘徊，潜伏在黑色的树后面，拿走它认为应得的一切。它留下了奇怪的谣言，其中有呼唤你进入灌木丛的声音、面孔、向窗户里看去的声音、雪地里神秘的脚印以及……一堆“儿童失踪”的海报。
那些听到森林之声的人都无能为力。他们唯一的选择就是越来越深地陷入恐怖的冰冷怀抱中，在冰冷的黑暗中面对自己的最终选择：是活下去还是做人？

故事发生在西伯利亚森林中一个安静、不起眼的村庄。主角安东最近和家人搬到了那里，几乎立即被迫目睹并参与了一系列令人不安的事件。这是一个儿童失踪的地方。警察无能为力，搜查队正在森林里搜寻，但没有发现任何踪迹。那么，为什么安东会不断地看到脚印、血迹和衣服碎片呢？感觉就像有人专门为他举办一场表演。起初他被噩梦困扰，每晚都变得越来越可怕和血腥。它们也变得越来越真实……并且令人向往。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249880/]Steam[/url]]
